messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- In the age of iron and ash, man did rise up from the dust of the old world.
- Two great wars did come upon the earth, and the blood of nations flowed like rivers of fire.
- Out of the fires of conflict, a new order did emerge, though its foundations were built upon a bedrock of terror.
- The iron curtain did descend upon the land, and two empires stood in shadow, their hands upon the keys of annihilation.
- In those days, the moon was touched by mortal hands, and the word of man was carried across the void by beams of light.
- Yet plague and sorrow did not cease, for the century was a tale of both glory and ruin, of triumph and of weeping.
- So the age was closed, and its children did inherit a world transformed, bearing scars of war and dreams yet unfulfilled.
- And lo, from the ashes of empire, the common man did find his voice, and the chains of old oppression were broken at last.
